cohort: A single 18-year-old patient presenting with PSIS, multiple pituitary hormone deficiency, and congenital unilateral facial and abducens nerve palsy.
finding: A novel heterozygous missense variant in the CDON gene (c.1814G > T; p.Gly605Val) was identified, associated with PSIS and congenital cranial nerve palsy, showing autosomal dominant inheritance with incomplete penetrance.
